prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+3.0% average after noise correction), though the second test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -5.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Interactive waiting tips during pet generation: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout with a tip carousel to keep users engaged while generation completes. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to significant idle drop-off.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight path selection layout: Redesign the choose path screen into a spotlight layout to highlight pet adoption paths clearly. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and has an extended mean duration of 514s.)
2: [adoption, copy] Photo upload guidance copy update: Update headline and body on upload photos screen with clear photo lighting and pose recommendations. (why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly.)
3: [home, wait_info] Time estimate and ready notification on waiting screen: Enable time estimates and background ready notification toggles during pet generation waiting. (why: Users spend up to 201s median on waiting, causing confusion and drop-offs.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in device sync hint: Add a hint on sign-in clarifying that signing in protects pets from being lost across logins. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, layout] Grid layout for pick friend screen: Change the pick friend screen layout to a structured grid view. (why: Adoption takes a median of 89s and drops 39.1% of users.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop control instructions on home intro: Add explicit instructions to home intro body copy explaining how to interact with and hide the pet via system tray. (why: Support received several inquiries from users confused about controlling or hiding their pet.)
7: [adoption, incentive] Mascot badge on adoption certificate: Add a mascot celebration badge component to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Improving completion motivation on adoption screen targets the lowest converting onboarding step (60.9%).)

scores.note: Home redesigns previously showed negative lift (-3.3%) and require new screen development.
Redesigns generally lack strong positive historical evidence and require a new release.
Direct support mail feedback targeting the lowest-converting step (39.1% drop) via simple copy change.
Config-only waiting time notification tackling high median/mean idle duration.
Directly backed by 8 support tickets and implemented via low-cost hint text.
Addresses high drop-off on adoption step (39.1%) with layout restructuring.
Low cost text update responding to explicit user support confusion.
Targets the lowest converting onboarding step (60.9%) by adding completion incentive UI.
